description: Uploads a file too large to send inline (over a few MB) into a workbook's attachments or a drive: returns a link to PUT the file to; then call again with `upload_id` to file it.

size.description: The file's size in bytes, when known: one over the limit is refused before uploading.

upload_id.description: Once the file is PUT: the upload_id the link came with.

name: upload
title: Upload a large file
